plugins.name: prompt-select
plugins.description: Shift+arrow selects text in the prompt box; copy-on-select, type/paste/backspace replaces it.

plugins.name: slash-fuzzy
plugins.description: Fuzzy-find slash commands and skills in the '/' typeahead (e.g. /jcm -> /jacky-commit-msg).

plugins.name: reply-style
plugins.description: Colored headers and shaded code blocks (with a language label and copy chip) in replies.

plugins.name: turn-footer
plugins.description: End time, tokens used and a one-line recap at the end of every reply.

plugins.name: answer-me-with-html
plugins.description: Answer hard questions with a one-page HTML explainer (copy of QingYunA/answer-me-with-html 0.5.10).
